This year’s ultimate festive dance track number has arrived! Presenting the exciting new song from the film Mitron, titled – Kamariya.
Starring Jackky Bhagnani and Kritika Kamra, Mitron is set to hit cinemas on the 14th of September,2018.
Welcome your Callers with the foot tapping song KAMARIYA!!!
